description: This source file defines the ContentPartHandlerCoordinator class, which manages the invocation of content part and field handlers during various content lifecycle events in OrchardCore CMS. It coordinates handler execution for actions like activation, creation, import, validation, publishing, and cloning, utilizing dependency injection and reflection to dynamically resolve and invoke handlers.

classes.name: ContentPartHandlerCoordinator
classes.description: A coordinator class that manages the invocation of content part and field handlers during various content lifecycle events such as activation, creation, import, validation, publishing, and cloning within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ContentPartHandlerCoordinator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies for handler resolution, factory creation, content definition management, and logging.

methods.name: ActivatingAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'activating' event, adding all parts and fields to a new content item based on its type definition.

methods.name: ActivatedAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'activated' event, invoking handlers after content parts and fields are activated.

methods.name: CreatingAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'creating' event, invoking handlers during content creation.

methods.name: CreatedAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'created' event, invoking handlers after content creation.

methods.name: ImportingAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'importing' event, invoking handlers during content import.

methods.name: ImportedAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'imported' event, invoking handlers after content import.

methods.name: InitializingAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'initializing' event, invoking handlers during content initialization.

methods.name: InitializedAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'initialized' event, invoking handlers after content initialization.

methods.name: LoadingAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'loading' event, adding missing parts/fields when loading existing content.

methods.name: LoadedAsync
methods.description: Handles the 'loaded' event, invoking handlers after content is loaded.

methods.name: ValidatingAsync
methods.description: Handles validation of content, invoking part and field validation handlers.

methods.name: ValidatedAsync

methods.description: Handles saving draft content, invoking draft-specific handlers.

methods.name: DraftSavedAsync

methods.name: PublishingAsync
methods.description: Handles content publishing, invoking publishing handlers.

methods.name: PublishedAsync

methods.name: RemovingAsync
methods.description: Handles content removal, invoking removal handlers.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Handles after content removal, invoking handlers.

methods.description: Handles unpublishing content, invoking unpublishing handlers.

methods.name: UnpublishedAsync

methods.description: Handles content updating, invoking updating handlers.

methods.name: UpdatedAsync
methods.description: Handles after content is updated, invoking handlers.

methods.name: VersioningAsync
methods.description: Handles versioning of content, invoking versioning handlers for existing and building content items.

methods.name: VersionedAsync
